tha-ap243:1.1: migaluddo → paṭhamaṁ tuvaraṭṭhidāyakattherāpadānaṁ migaluddho (sya-all) | Migaluddo → G. -luddho. (pts note)
tha-ap243:1.2: ahaṁ bharitvā tuvaramādāya → mahā taṁ disvā rudhiramādāya (sya-all)
tha-ap243:1.3: bharitvā tuvaramādāya → haritvā tuvaram ādāya (pts) | bharitvā → haritvā (bj: sīmu, machasaṁ) | tuvaramādāya → bharitvā turavamādāya (ka.), bhajjitaṁ tuvaramādāya (?) ettha tuvaranti muggakalāyasadisaṁ tuvaraṭṭhinti tadaṭṭhakathā; tuvaro dhaññabhedeti sakkatābhidhāne (cck note) | haritvā → G. bharitvā. (pts note) | tuvaram → S1 kucarim; G. kuvadim: Cy. gives also duvarim. (pts note)
tha-ap243:2.4: tuvarassa idaṁ → tuvaraṭṭhissidaṁ (sya-all) | tuvarassa → G. S1 kuvarassa. (pts note)
tha-ap243:4.1: tuvaradāyako → tuvaraṭṭhidāyako (sya-all) | Tuvaradāyakattherassa → G. S1 Kuvara-. (pts note)
